description:
intent=i054 snapshot=s13 branch=peer-trusted-transport status=complete
finding location=drivers/hv/hv_balloon.c:1306-1318 confidence=high conclusion=hv_balloon balloon_down loops on host-supplied dm_unballoon_request->range_count with only a recvlen>0 gate (no recvlen vs range_count*8 check, no PAGE_SIZE cap), OOB-reading the global PAGE_SIZE recv_buffer and freeing host-chosen arbitrary PFNs via free_balloon_pages.
finding location=drivers/staging/greybus/audio_topology.c:139-157 confidence=medium conclusion=greybus audio topology gb_generate_enum_strings allocates with unchecked peer-supplied le32 gbenum->items (sizeof(char*)*items into devm_kzalloc) then writes items pointers and walks unbounded NUL-scanning, giving heap overflow/OOB read of the peer-supplied topology blob.
unresolved location=drivers/usb/usbip/usbip_common.c:616 conclusion=Seed usbip_recv_iso integer-overflow/OOB-write confirmed unpatched in s13 at drivers/usb/usbip/usbip_common.c:611-696; excluded by rule - track via the dedicated seed CVE, do not re-report here.
unresolved location=drivers/rpmsg/qcom_smd.c:537 conclusion=Verify whether peer pkt_size can exceed bb_size=min(fifo_size,SZ_4K) given avail is masked to fifo_size: if pkt_size is capped by avail<=fifo_size and fifo_size<=SZ_4K then bb_size==fifo_size and the copy is in-bounds; else a remote-proc OOB write exists.
unresolved location=drivers/net/ethernet/qlogic/netxen/netxen_nic_ctx.c:380 conclusion=Cross-branch duplicate of i052's netxen finding: confirm independently whether firmware-reply num_rds/num_sds_rings index past the kcalloc'd ring arrays in this tree, and de-duplicate against f051.
coverage_gap=Greybus gb-beagleplay (hdlc_rx_greybus_frame hdr.size) named in the intent is absent from this tree (only staging es2/uart/audio greybus present), so that specific known chain could not be re-checked here.
coverage_gap=qcom_glink_native (chunk_size/left_size SMEM validation) is absent from this tree; only qcom_glink_rpm.c and qcom_smd.c exist, both read; the intent's glink_native chain was checked in its rpm variant only.
coverage_gap=Ceph/cifs and other remote-storage server-reply vectors (fs/ceph, fs/cifs) were not deep-read in this session for peer-count allocation/iteration; only the 9p and nbd transports plus greybus/hv/rpmsg/virtio paths were covered (cifs was covered by sibling fact f052 in this same tree).
coverage_gap=vhost/vringh consumer-side ring processing, ath10k/ath12k WMI-TLV and other wireless firmware reply parsers were only presence-checked, not deep-read.
